description: The file defines the LoggerCategory class, which is part of a PHP logging framework ported from log4j. It manages logging categories, including appender attachments, log levels, and message logging methods.

classes.name: LoggerCategory
classes.description: Represents a logging category for managing log messages, appenders, and levels within a PHP logging framework ported from log4j.

methods.name: addAppender
methods.description: Attaches a new appender to the category.

methods.name: assertLog
methods.description: Logs an error message if the assertion is false.

methods.name: callAppenders
methods.description: Invokes all attached appenders to process a logging event.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level if enabled.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level if enabled.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a logger with the specified name exists (deprecated).

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs a message at FATAL level if enabled.

methods.name: forcedLog
methods.description: Creates and logs a logging event directly, bypassing level checks.

methods.name: getAdditivity
methods.description: Returns whether child categories inherit appenders.

methods.name: getAllAppenders
methods.description: Retrieves all attached appenders.

methods.name: getAppender
methods.description: Finds a specific appender by name.

methods.name: getChainedPriority
methods.description: Deprecated. Returns effective level.

methods.name: getCurrentCategories
methods.description: Returns current loggers (deprecated).

methods.name: getDefaultHierarchy
methods.description: Returns the logger repository (deprecated).

methods.name: getHierarchy
methods.description: Deprecated alias for getLoggerRepository.

methods.name: getEffectiveLevel
methods.description: Returns the first non-null level up the hierarchy.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a logger by name.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the assigned level for this category.

methods.name: getLoggerRepository
methods.description: Returns the logger repository.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the category's name.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent category.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Deprecated. Same as getLevel.

methods.name: getResourceBundle
methods.description: Returns the resource bundle for localization.

methods.name: getResourceBundleString
methods.description: Fetches a string from the resource bundle.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root logger.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level if enabled.

methods.name: isAttached
methods.description: Checks if an appender is attached.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if DEBUG level is enabled.

methods.name: isEnabledFor
methods.description: Determines if a given level is enabled.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if INFO level is enabled.

methods.name: l7dlog
methods.description: Logs a localized parameterized message.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level.

methods.name: removeAllAppenders
methods.description: Detaches all appenders.

methods.name: removeAppender
methods.description: Removes a specified appender by object or name.

methods.name: setAdditivity
methods.description: Sets whether child categories inherit appenders.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Deprecated. Sets the log level.

methods.name: setHierarchy
methods.description: Assigns a logger hierarchy.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level.

methods.name: setResourceBundle
methods.description: Configures localization resource bundle.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the logging system (deprecated).

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level.
